title: Listen and Choose a Response — Course Registration

questions.stem: Which section of statistics did you sign up for?

options.A: Statistics is a required course for my major.
options.B: I signed the form and handed it in.
options.C: Yes, I signed up last week.
options.D: I haven't decided yet; both times are tricky for me.

questions.explanation: The speaker asks which section; saying the choice isn't made yet and why is a natural indirect reply.
